explicit_gaps: No live Defender tenant export, Event Hub/streaming API delivery, Advanced Hunting export, or collector relay was exercised by adding this harness.
The harness uses synthetic-equivalent fixture JSON and does not prove API pagination, checkpoint custody, collector envelope metadata, incident/post-delivery table coverage, or export completeness.
Passing the harness would be lab replay/read-back evidence for this fixture route only, not field validation for a real Defender tenant.

pack_variants.label: Defender XDR JSON relay
pack_variants.description: Default variant for Defender XDR API/Event Hub/Cribl relays that preserve one JSON object per event and the originating Microsoft Defender XDR advanced-hunting table name, including selected endpoint, alert, identity, cloud app, email-security, and registry event tables.
known_limitations: No live Defender relay replay/read-back captured.
Collector wrappers may rename or nest fields and must be compared locally.
Fixture coverage is representative for selected public Defender table names, including selected email and registry tables, not exhaustive Microsoft Defender XDR schema coverage.

cribl.notes: Use after sampling the local Defender feed. Do not drop command line, alert evidence, file path/hash, URL/IP, or account context by default.

vector.notes: Vector support is recorded as a conservative sources/transforms/sinks mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Vector config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

fluent_bit.notes: Fluent Bit support is recorded as a conservative collector/pipeline mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Fluent Bit config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

validation_commands: Start Data Prepper with the generated pipelines.yaml in a disposable test container and confirm pipeline startup before replay/read-back.
data_prepper.notes: Data Prepper support is recorded as a conservative OpenSearch ingestion pipeline mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Data Prepper pipeline artifact is generated by this pack yet.

opensearch_dashboards.config_model: index pattern/data view -> saved objects NDJSON -> dashboard/visualizations
validation_commands: Import exported NDJSON into a disposable OpenSearch Dashboards space and confirm data view/index-pattern resolution.
opensearch_dashboards.notes: OpenSearch Dashboards support is recorded as visualization-target metadata only. Splunk dashboards, where present, have not been automatically translated to OpenSearch saved objects or live-tested.

known_limitations: No live Defender relay, SC4S runtime replay, or Splunk read-back evidence; keep curated/unverified and do not promote to validated/verified.
Fixtures are synthetic-equivalent examples, not real tenant records.
SC4S emits pack-defined family sourcetypes; exact collector wrapping/source names and table availability need local comparison.
Reduction candidates are opt-in and review-required; no default lossy drops are included.
Identity and CloudAppEvents coverage is synthetic-equivalent and limited to selected public advanced hunting table names.

Defender for Office 365 email, DeviceRegistryEvents, and TVM coverage is limited to selected public advanced-hunting table fields; incidents, EmailPostDeliveryEvents, device assessment joins, exposure-score/remediation workflow fields, and full schema parity remain future work.
